items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...jazz, F. Scott Fitzgerald and Princeton all go together. [INTERVIEWEE] All go together.

ctx.x: and do these things, had I wanted to. But I really didn't want to -- I wanted to stay; stick with what I was in to.

Yeah. Well, of course, "The Great Gatsby" was very appropriate because that was the novel by F. Scott Fitzgerald, who went to Princeton, and forever -- correctly or incorrectly -- jazz, F. Scott Fitzgerald and Princeton all go together.
